thread:
ada: Quick sync from the postmortem — need owners for: statuspage copy, customer summary, RCA-sharing policy (consent/redaction), and recurrence analysis. Keep replies short so CS has one thread.

ryan: I9ll take the statuspage + a one-paragraph customer note. Will post consumer + enterprise variants by EOD.

sophia: I can draft the RCA-sharing policy and consent checkbox. Proposal: public summary within 48h, full sanitized RCA within 7 days, raw logs only if customer opts in. Will add redaction checklist.

leo: I9ll run the recurrence check (60/90 day), flag any repeat-affected accounts, and recommend short-term and long-term mitigations. Deliverable: short slide + suggested owners. Due in 7 days.

ada: Good. Ryan/sophia: include clear ETAs in the tracker and tag Legal if enterprise wording needed. Ops: please create JIRA tasks.

ops-bot: Created tickets: INC-18801 (statuspage + customer blurb) -> ryan, due 2025-12-05; INC-18802 (RCA sharing policy + consent mock) -> sophia, due 2025-12-03; INC-18803 (recurrence 60/90 day analysis) -> leo, due 2025-12-10. Reminder set for 48h.

ryan: Draft posted to tracker: "We experienced intermittent write latency affecting a small number of customers. Mitigations were applied to reduce impact; we are investigating root cause and will publish a full incident report in 7 days." Consumer copy uses "a few customers" per CS preference.

sophia: Redaction checklist: redact customer IDs, IPs, internal hostnames, exact timestamps tied to accounts; keep anonymized timeline and aggregated metrics. Consent language mock: "I authorize Redwood to share sanitized logs for troubleshooting under the described redaction rules."

ada: Decision: default publish summary publicly; sanitized RCA in 7 days; logs require explicit opt-in. For enterprise accounts, coordinate timing with AM/Legal and flag in tracker.

leo: I'll surface accounts with repeated KV hits and add priority tags so CS/AM can do targeted outreach.

irene: For action tracking, I'll keep the tracker updated and mark tickets in-progress as owners start work. If owners miss the 48h interim, ops should publish the interim summary + statuspage link.

ada: Thanks. Keep updates short in this thread and paste JIRA links into the tracker so CS has a single source of truth. I'll follow up Monday morning if anything is still open. :thumbsup:

[end of thread]
